proof.text: Exactness for U and W gives exactness for the composite inverse image by the unit-compatible isomorphism. In degree zero evaluate on the universal generator, apply each family normalization and the unit equation, and cancel the isomorphism. In positive degree embed the coefficient in an injective, lift through its surjective boundary, apply the two boundary identities and induction. Naturality of extension classes for the short-complex morphism with components e.inv supplies the final equality.
